def self_test(self):
        if self.controller.busy:return
        from .window_placement import browser_anchor
        browser = dict(self.controller.local.get('browser', {}))
        browser['_window_anchor'] = browser_anchor(self.root)
        self.controller.busy=True;self.set_busy_controls('disabled')
        def work():
            from .selftest import run_selftest
            active=self.controller.local.get('_overrides_path')
            if active and not self.controller.local.get('_overrides_loaded') and not Path(active).exists():active=None
            try:self.controller.events.put(('selftest',run_selftest(browser,active)))
            except Exception:self.controller.events.put(('selftest',{'status':'FAIL','code':'CFG-003','summary':'Self-Test unavailable; validate the complete local bundle'}))
            finally:self.controller.events.put(('idle',None))
        threading.Thread(target=work,daemon=True).start()
